rationale: The agent did locate the user and referenced the order/product, but it executed an order-changing write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming with the user, violating the policy that requires explicit confirmation before any order changes. There is no evidence it attempted to place a new order first (as the user preferred) or that it informed the user it could not do so before proceeding with an exchange. Additionally, the agent provided no final details about the exchange outcome (cost differences, return/shipping steps, timelines), which fails the requirement to give correct final information. While minimal authentication via name and ZIP appears to have been used, the lack of confirmation before acting and missing final info constitute clear failures under the stated policy.
